info.title: austit_talk-full
info.description: Geheime Unterhaltungen und Talk-Administration für ausgewählte Benutzer

get.summary: Tells the requesting user which Talk administration rights they have

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The Talk administration access of the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Returns the Talk settings this app exposes

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The Talk settings this app exposes

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Changes one of the Talk settings this app exposes

value.description: new value of the setting, JSON is accepted as well

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The Talk settings this app exposes

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Lists the groups for the Talk administration settings

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The groups for the Talk administration settings

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Stores a crash report of the austit Talk Android app

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Tells whether a conversation is a secret conversation and whether the user moderates it

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The secret state of the conversation

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Turns a conversation into a secret conversation or ends the protection

lease.description: seconds the messages and shared files of the conversation stay, 0 lifts the protection

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The secret state of the conversation

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Lists the Talk administrators and whether they may use the Talk administration

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: only users whose id or display name contain this are listed

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The administrators and whether they may use the Talk administration

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

post.summary: Grants or revokes access to the Talk administration for an administrator

userId.description: id of the administrator whose access is changed

allowed.description: whether the administrator may use the Talk administration

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: The updated access of the administrator

401.description: Current user is not logged in

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

tags.name: crash
tags.description: Receives crash reports from the austit Talk Android app. Only logged-in users can submit; reports are kept in the app data folder "crashes" and picked up by the server monitor.
